provider_surface.role: live provider runtime, endpoints, cache, retry and smoke orchestration
provider identities, fixture-backed results and Sourceright-specific candidate models

drift_from_original_inventory: none in Cargo.toml, src/providers.rs or src/live_providers.rs

quality_gate.command: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test && cargo check --locked

limitations: No Sourceright file, branch, pull request or remote state was modified.
The baseline gate does not compile a shared-core feature or produce old/new parity evidence.
